title: Wire contradiction-aware recency tagging into chatbot/memory/retrieval.py
description:
Wire contradiction-aware recency tagging into chatbot/memory/retrieval.py. Integrate timescale structuring and confidence scoring. Ensure newer memories tag/supersede contradictory older ones, and low-confidence memories are filtered. Maintain graceful fallback when embeddings are absent.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- chatbot/memory/timescale.py
- chatbot/memory/confidence.py

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/memory/retrieval.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: break current retrieval paths when embeddings are missing

allowed: resolve contradiction by timestamp or sequence comparison
add tag flags to returned memory objects
